posts.title: Beyond The Chip: How AI Is Reshaping Semiconductor Design And Manufacturing
posts.summary:
Power delivery, connectivity, advanced packaging, and supply chain resilience are emerging as the primary constraints on AI scaling. 
The post Beyond The Chip: How AI Is Reshaping Semiconductor Design And Manufacturing appeared first on Semiconductor Engineering.
bullets: AI scaling is increasingly constrained by factors beyond transistor density, specifically power delivery, connectivity, advanced packaging, and supply chain resilience.
Intel Foundry is integrating AI and machine learning into manufacturing operations to accelerate yield learning and improve product quality.
The industry is transitioning from a monolithic System-on-Chip (SoC) model to a 'system of chips' architecture, driven by the demands of agentic and physical AI.

posts.title: Built to Last: Why Automotive-Grade PQC Can’t Wait
posts.summary:
Why automotive-grade PQC IP matters, what sets it apart from general-purpose PQC, and what SoC design teams should look for when choosing a PQC accelerator.
The post Built to Last: Why Automotive-Grade PQC Can’t Wait appeared first on Semiconductor Engineering.
bullets: Automotive SoCs require long-term security planning because vehicles remain in service for decades, necessitating a transition to quantum-resistant cryptography.
Automotive-grade post-quantum cryptography (PQC) differs from general-purpose implementations due to stringent safety, reliability, and fault-monitoring requirements.
Design teams are encouraged to adopt hybrid cryptographic approaches and specialized PQC accelerators to ensure platform adaptability against evolving quantum threats.

posts.title: BYD Yangwang debuts Altior, targeting ultra-luxury executive sedan market
posts.summary:
As BYD's halo brand, Yangwang is pushing further into the ultra-luxury executive sedan market with the 5.6-meter Altior.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: BYD's ultra-luxury brand, Yangwang, has unveiled the Altior, a 5.6-meter executive sedan designed to compete directly with the Mercedes-Maybach S-Class and Bentley Flying Spur.
The limited-edition 'Shanhe Dingyun' model is capped at 399 units globally, with an estimated price point of 2,080,000 yuan and a required deposit of 300,000 yuan.
The vehicle features a high-end executive configuration, including coach doors, a four-seat layout with individual rear consoles, and premium materials like Hetian jade and aramid fiber.
This launch marks a significant strategic push by BYD to capture the ultra-luxury segment, leveraging advanced design and exclusive branding to challenge established European luxury marques.

posts.title: BYD Fang Cheng Bao confirms Tai 6 model, Formula SL expected in 2027
posts.summary:
The Tai 6 was mentioned for the first time by an executive at Fang Cheng Bao, but no details were disclosed.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Fang Cheng Bao has confirmed the development of the 'Tai 6' model and expects to launch the Formula SL in 2027, signaling a continued expansion of its product portfolio.
The brand is maintaining a rapid release cadence, with the 6-seat Tai 9 SUV scheduled for November and the Shark pickup truck expected to enter the Chinese market in December.
Management is currently addressing production bottlenecks for the Formula S series, with deliveries of the DiSus C-equipped models expected to commence by mid-to-late November.
The brand is diversifying its lineup beyond hardcore off-roaders to include sedans, shooting brakes, and pickups to capture a broader range of consumer segments.

posts.title: Nio Firefly wins 2026 Red Dot Award for smart cockpit design
posts.summary:
Firefly Aster OS wins the Brands & Communication Design award in the Interface & User Experience Design category.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Nio's Firefly brand received the 2026 Red Dot Award for its Aster OS Multisensory Smart Cockpit, highlighting its focus on interface design and user experience in the premium compact EV market.
The Aster OS 2.1.5 update has been released, enabling support for a new 60-kWh long-range battery pack that increases CLTC range to 560 kilometers.
Firefly continues to leverage Nio's battery-swapping infrastructure, allowing owners of standard-range models to upgrade their range flexibility through the new battery option.
The brand is utilizing design-focused marketing and special editions, such as the Halo series and Club Spiaggia, to maintain market visibility against competitors like Mini and Smart.
